topic: GitLost: We Tricked GitHub's AI Agent into Leaking Private Repos
headline: GitLost: Trickery Unveiled
caption: As a full stack engineer, seeing this GitLost story is both fascinating and a little concerning. It highlights how AI integrations, even well-intentioned ones, can be manipulated to leak sensitive info. We need to rethink how these systems are secured and how they handle private data. Always remember to test your security layers and stay vigilant in this rapidly evolving AI landscape ✨. Have you tested your repo security against AI-based threats yet? Keep coding smart! 💻 #CyberSecurity #AIsecurity #DevLife
